Eight countries to choose from

Compare intakes and course lengths

  • United Kingdom

    One-year master’s degrees, two main intakes, and our own office in the country.

  • United States

    The widest choice of universities and courses, with work options after STEM degrees.

  • Canada

    Universities and public colleges, three intakes a year, and work rights that depend on your course.

  • Australia

    Highly ranked universities, February and July intakes, and a graduate visa after you finish.

  • Germany

    Low or no tuition at many public universities, and strong engineering and technology courses.

  • Ireland

    English-speaking, one-year master’s degrees, and a base for many global technology and pharma companies.

  • France

    Well-known business and engineering schools, with a large number of master’s courses taught in English.

  • New Zealand

    Eight public universities, February and July intakes, and a work visa for eligible graduates.

Search 64 universities

Pick a country and a subject to see which universities teach it, at bachelor’s or master’s level.

From first conversation to boarding gate

Five stops, in this order. We tell you which one you are at, and what comes next.

What we help with
  1. 1

    Talk to a counsellor

    Tell us your marks, your budget and what you want to study. Walk in, call or WhatsApp.

  2. 2

    Get your shortlist

    We suggest universities and courses that match your profile, and explain why.

  3. 3

    Apply

    We help with documents and your statement of purpose, then track each application.

  4. 4

    Get your visa

    We check your financial documents and visa form, and prepare you for the interview.

  5. 5

    Fly

    Before you leave we cover accommodation, forex and what to pack.
